create_experiment_config: create an ExperimentConfig from YAML and set on-policy and off-policy training parameters
build_mlp_sequence: build a SequenceModelConfig with stacked MlpConfig layers and intermediate sizes
build_cnn_sequence: build a SequenceModelConfig with a CnnConfig followed by an MlpConfig layer
build_gnn_sequence: build a SequenceModelConfig with MlpConfig and GnnConfig layers using GATv2Conv
build_gru_lstm_sequence: build a SequenceModelConfig with GruConfig or LstmConfig recurrent layers and MLP heads
